title: After a screening save the mirror keeps its cached PSA flag until the next record read
evidence: US-34 AC11: every mirror writer goes through widget-src/src/lib/chat-mirror.ts writeMirror, which builds the whole mirror with the pure mirrorOf; the PSA flag (planPsa) and the lab eGFR (labEgfrOf) are worked out there at every write, so a landed screening save (useListSaves mirrorSavedLists) moves the lists and the flag together. patchMirror is deleted. Tests: lib/chat-mirror.test.ts, hooks/useListSaves.mirror.test.tsx.
